kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
remote-ssh-authorized-keys:
  set -eu
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh"
  chmod 700 "$HOME/.ssh"
  key_file="$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
  tmp_keys="$(mktemp)"
  tmp_new="$(mktemp)"
  touch "$key_file"
  chmod 600 "$key_file"
  cat > "$tmp_new" <<'EOF'
  ssh-ed25519 AAAATESTKEY erun-integration
  EOF
  grep -Fvx -f "$tmp_new" "$key_file" > "$tmp_keys" || true
  cat "$tmp_new" >> "$tmp_keys"
  mv "$tmp_keys" "$key_file"
  rm -f "$tmp_new"
  chmod 600 "$key_file"
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev port-forward deployment/team-devops 26122:26122 --address <LOOPBACK>
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR erun-team-dev true
==> Doctor done team/dev
